name: 33418 · Palm Bch Gdns, FL
findings: ZIP 33418 (Palm Bch Gdns) has 235 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33418 (Palm Bch Gdns) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33418 (Palm Bch Gdns) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
